snippet.title: Fret Smasher - Public Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
The Fret Smasher Playtest goes public on Feb 7th 2026! 

The Playtest Includes:
- Classic Play
- Classic Face-Off (Local & VS Bots)
- Classic Battle (Local & VS Bots)
- Careers
- Streamer VS Chat
- Practice Mode
- Themes
- Steam Workshop Support (Charts, Themes, Careers, Highways and Backgrounds)
- Leaderboards
- Custom Chart Support (.chart and .mid formats)

Additional features will be added as development continues such as Online, Drums, Quickplay (new score system!) and more!

Don't forget to join our Discord server to report bugs and to drop your ideas for what else we should add to the game! - https://discordapp.com/invite/F8vZW85

--

Fret Smasher is a brand new band styled rhythm game that is aimed to not only bring back classic play, but also new ways of play through new game modes, score systems and more!

--

Visit Our Website - https://lavoiestudios.ca/games/fret-smasher/

Fret Smasher On Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/14...

Join our Discord - https://discordapp.com/invite/F8vZW85

Follow our BlueSky - https://bsky.app/profile/fretsmasher.bsky.social

--

Developed and Published by: Lavoie Studios

Disclaimer: The number of songs shown on the song scanner is done through community customs. The game only comes with 14 official songs as of this upload date. Customs can be downloaded via the Steam Workshop or from community members.
